questions.label: True premises
questions.prompt: Select every model in which both P and Q are true.
questions.explanation: M₁ and M₂ make both premises true.

questions.label: Countermodels
questions.prompt: Select every model in which both premises are true and C is false.
questions.explanation: M₂ is a countermodel: it belongs to [P] and [Q], but not [C]. The inference is invalid in this model space.

questions.label: Living things
questions.prompt: Select every pictured member of this set.
questions.explanation: The three people, rabbit, mouse, and mushroom are alive. The robot is a machine.

questions.label: Boxes
questions.prompt: Select every pictured member of this set.
questions.explanation: Both cardboard boxes belong. The school is a building, not a box, even though it has a rectangular shape.

questions.label: Beverages
questions.prompt: Select every pictured member of this set.
questions.explanation: The soda and beer are beverages.

questions.label: Alive, but not human
questions.prompt: Select every pictured member of this set.
questions.formula: { x : x is alive and x is not human }
questions.explanation: The rabbit, mouse, and mushroom are alive but not human. A mushroom is a fungus, not an animal.

questions.label: Boxes or beverages
questions.prompt: Select every pictured member of this set.
questions.formula: { x : x is a box or x is a beverage }
questions.explanation: Both boxes, the soda, and the beer satisfy at least one of the two conditions.

questions.label: Living boxes
questions.prompt: Select every pictured member of this set.
questions.formula: { x : x is a box and x is alive }
questions.explanation: No pictured object satisfies both conditions. This set is empty, so select nothing.
